mapper.select: SELECT e.user_id AS userId, e.name AS name, d.name AS department, jp.name AS position FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = e.department_id LEFT JOIN job_position jp ON jp.job_position_id = e.job_position_id WHERE e.is_system = 0 AND e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.resigned_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY e.name ASC
